posts.title: Disparate Results with AI - Just a Skill Issue?

posts.title: The Useful Uselessness of Play
posts.description: Play is accepted as having an important role in the development of problem-solving skills and resilience in children. Play provides children with opportunities to explore simplified, low-stakes versions of real-world situations, helping them build skills that transfer to more complex and consequential challenges later in life.
